evidence_plan.requirement: Identify the baselines used in the study

payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about various baselines used in the study, including vanilla ST, pre-training, and multi-task baselines.

claims.text: The study uses a vanilla ST baseline, which includes only a speech encoder and a decoder.
Three pre-training baselines are conducted: encoder pre-training, decoder pre-training, and encoder-decoder pre-training.
Multi-task baseline experiments include one-to-many, many-to-one, and many-to-many settings.
